title: Distance after one coordinate change
statement: For every $n\ge 0$, every vector $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$, every coordinate $i$, and every $c\in\mathbb F_2$, the Hamming distance from $x$ to the vector obtained by adding $c$ at coordinate $i$ is at most $1$.
